notes.title: Gridform Playtest LIVE
notes.notes:
[h1]Alpha Playtest is LIVE[/h1]
The game will be available to play from now until Sunday July 11th.


[h2]Is it too late to sign up?[/h2]
No, (for now) the test will be completely open to new users. You will get access immediatly if you request access on the games store page. If too many people join the test I will probably limit this.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608710/Gridform/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40375420/402819dff4c3ea509558243632423e15eeed9326.png[/img][/url]

[h2]If you encounter a problem[/h2]
[i]Please[/i] let me know what is wrong through [url=https://discord.gg/NHqsBw8nRv]Discord[/url].


[h2]How to give feedback[/h2]
The best way to give feedback is to join the games [url=https://discord.gg/NHqsBw8nRv]Discord[/url] and leave your thoughts there.

notes.title: Upcoming Gridform Alpha Test
notes.notes:
[h1]Friday July 9th - Sunday July 11th[/h1]
A limited alpha build will be available through Steam.

[h2]What will be in the build?[/h2]
The build will feature a selection of 9 levels with the purpose of gauging first impressions and the games difficulty/learning curve.
Depending on your skill level there will be up to about 30 minutes of gameplay.

[h2]How to sign up[/h2]
You can sign up early by requesting access on the games store page.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608710/Gridform/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40375420/402819dff4c3ea509558243632423e15eeed9326.png[/img][/url]

[h2]How to give feedback[/h2]
The best way to give feedback is to join the games [url=https://discord.gg/NHqsBw8nRv]Discord[/url] and leave your thoughts there.

ALL FEEDBACK IS WELCOME, if you hated what you played let me know.
